name: Yoon Sang-jeong
bio: Yoon Sang-jeong (born January 17, 1998) is a South Korean actress.

credits.title: The Intern
credits.overview: Ki-ho, a retiree with 37 years of experience, joins fashion start-up WOO22 a senior intern, he struggles with its digital, unconventional culture. Despite their differences, Ki-ho and Sun-woo, the start-up's young CEO, learn from each other and form an unexpected bond.

credits.title: Adagio
credits.overview: A man and a woman going through middle age crisis encounter each other in a peaceful seaside village. Despite the different background, classical music becomes an instrument to connect the hearts of these two lonely and hurt souls.
